name: zdi_set_current_variant
description: zDi::SetCurrentVariant updates a material cycle's current texture entry and currentFrame, wrapping indices at frameCount and clamping negative indices to zero.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Binary Ninja HLIL keeps redundant stack temporaries around the original fild source slot, but the assembly and behavior are clear.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja reconstruction and assembly for 0x4842b0 validate material/cycle lookup, null-cycle return, modulo wrap for variantIndex >= frameCount, negative clamp to zero, currentTextureDirectoryEntry update from frameTable[variantIndex], and currentFrame as the normalized variant index converted to float.
The native zDi smoke verifies direct index selection, modulo wrap, negative clamp, and null-cycle no-op behavior.
